purpose: Canonical conversational gateway and operational memory for autonomous agents scanning, triaging, implementing, and tracking upstream non-Web3 OSS contributions.

agent_directive.before_action: Read this file before proposing, claiming, implementing, or submitting a new upstream target.
agent_directive.after_action: Update this file after every meaningful outcome: new target, competing PR, maintainer feedback, review request, merge, closure, auto-close, rejection, or change in refile/duplicate eligibility.
hard_exclusions: Do not duplicate work already represented by an active or completed contribution unless upstream state has materially changed.
Do not refile targets marked do_not_refile=true unless new upstream information explicitly changes that decision.
Do not target issues with visible owner/claim, reserved maintainer work, or a competing PR covering the same semantics.
Do not submit work that repository policy or AI-assistance policy makes unsuitable.
Do not compete with a PR that appeared after the current scan; refresh upstream state immediately before acting.
Web3/crypto work is excluded from this ledger and belongs in the separate Web3 workflow.
agent_directive.freshness_rule: Triage memory is historical/operational context, not a substitute for a live GitHub check. Re-check issue, PR, assignees, comments, reviews, CI, mergeability, and competing work before action.
agent_directive.scan_output_rule: Dated scan files should record only what is new on their date; carryover rows verified unchanged do not need to be repeated.
agent_directive.implementation_rule: Prefer bounded, reproducible patches with regression tests where the repository has an applicable test suite; validate against the exact upstream default branch before claiming correctness.

selection_criteria: Target fits the contributor's practical stack.
Patch scope is bounded and locally testable.
No visible owner, reserved work, or competing pull request covers the same work.
Expected behavior is sufficiently clear to implement without speculative design.
Fix is not already present on current upstream main/default branch.
Work is not mainly churn, documentation trivia, or difficult to validate locally.
Target does not refile work previously auto-closed, rejected, or otherwise excluded in this ledger.
preflight_checklist: Refresh issue state, assignees, comments, and cross-referenced PRs via the core GitHub API.
Read the relevant triage records in this file, including prior attempts, competing PRs, maintainer feedback, and exclusion flags.
Re-read the target repository's contribution and AI-assistance policy.
Reproduce on the exact upstream default branch, not only the latest release.
Post a concise, human-reviewed claim/approach comment only where repository etiquette calls for it.
Keep the patch bounded and add a failing-first regression where tests exist.
Run the narrow test, formatter/linter/type checker, then the feasible package suite.
Link the issue with the repository's required keyword and disclose AI assistance where required.
Refresh competing-PR state immediately before submission; never knowingly compete with newer upstream work.

scan_mechanics.issue_discovery: Bulk issue discovery uses the core repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues?labels=bug endpoint rather than the search API because rapid search calls can trigger GitHub's secondary rate limit.
scan_mechanics.competing_pr_detection: Use per-issue timeline cross-referenced events and resolve referenced URLs as PRs. A foreign-repo cross-reference that cannot be resolved as a PR is noise, not an open competitor.

pull_requests.summary: Z-index portal layer <g> elements no longer carry tabindex="-1", preventing pointer focus on empty SVG layer groups and WebKit geometry-traced focus rings. Regression asserts rendered layer groups have no tabindex attribute.
Connection.sync() no longer sets _ending, so later ECONNRESET/EPIPE errors are not swallowed for the connection lifetime. Regression + integration tests.
Honor lockfile: false with devEngines.packageManager.onFail: download: skip project env-lockfile sync, keep package-manager download/switch. Rust + TypeScript + tests + changeset.
pnpm update pkg@x.y.z keeps the manifest's existing ^/~ operator and supported npm: / jsr: prefixes.
Non-recursive pnpm run "/pattern/" --no-bail no longer kills sibling scripts after the first failure.
Move ModelTest.create_test() to the calling thread so execution_time / time_machine use cannot race across workers.
test(open-api): lock in requestBody for /phone-number/verify.
Add useBetterDomTraversing nursery rule ported from eslint-plugin-unicorn.
portable-atomic feature forwards to ratatui-widgets; Block shadow switches Arc import for no_std targets without atomic pointers.
create_external_models quotes case-sensitive column names so generated external_models.yaml round-trips correctly.
Config device plugin reports used virtual slots as Unhealthy so kubelet avoids slots still held during reclaim grace period.
@next/codemod upgrade keeps a satisfying eslint specifier; only bumps below-range specs to the highest release of the lowest satisfying major.
PYI002 diagnostic reworded to name the stub-file context; message-only, behavior unchanged.
Widen email/deletion callback user typing to User & Record<string, any> so user.additionalFields is visible.
Async CancelledError now emits TaskFailedEvent before re-raise so execution spans pop and retained Task/Agent/Crew graphs can GC.
Public SpeechHandle.hold_interruptions() context manager plus less severe realtime log path.
Cancel false-interruption resume timer on non-empty interim/preflight STT while paused; maintainer semantics conflict noted.
Fix retain-then-strip search middleware so Link/buildLocation without search omits stripped defaults.
Coalesce session-signal bursts so overlapping notifies do not cancel in-flight /get-session.
JS port of CVE-2026-71433: stop namespace sibling leakage in search for InMemory and Postgres stores.
drizzle-kit pull no longer treats every two-FK domain table as a many-to-many junction.
Malformed JSON server-function payloads return 400 instead of unhandled 500.
Fix fetch({ redirect: 'follow' }) hanging when a large 3xx redirect body pins the only keep-alive socket.
